findings.what: Home-user Wahl-type clipper blade replacement interval
findings.value: 12-24 months home use (vs 6-12 months professional daily use)
findings.quote: Home users usually replace blades every 12 to 24 months, while professionals running clippers daily should swap them out every 6 to 12 months.

findings.what: Clipper guard/comb attachment lifespan (qualitative, before becoming brittle and breaking)
findings.quote: Regarding the guards and combs, they become brittle in time (several years). The tab will break off and no longer keep the guide fixed to the clipper.

findings.what: Average human fingernail growth rate, healthy American young adults study
findings.quote: Average fingernail growth rate was 3.47 mm/month, according to a study of healthy American young adults. Normal fingernail growth is assumed to vary from less than 1.8 and to more than 4.5 mm per month.

findings.what: Average human toenail growth rate, same study
findings.quote: fingernail growth rate of 3.47 mm/month and toenails 1.62 mm/month

findings.what: Recommended/typical fingernail trimming interval (consumer health advice, not a formal survey)
findings.quote: Most people benefit from trimming fingernails every one to two weeks to prevent snagging and manage length consistently.

findings.what: Recommended/typical toenail trimming interval (consumer health advice, not a formal survey)
findings.quote: trimming every four to six weeks is usually plenty for most people
